abilities.name: Vanish and Reappear
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Nighthaunt unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: There Is No Escape
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Nighthaunt unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • The target unit can still use Charge and Shoot abilities even if it has used a Retreat ability in the same turn. • The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Lethal Rancour
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly Nighthaunt units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The targets' melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Nighthaunt Hero to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use Retreat abilities while they are in combat with the target.

abilities.name: Greedy for Souls
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Nexus of Grief to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target has a Move characteristic of 3". It can immediately move up to 3" and can move into combat but cannot end that move on a terrain feature or within 3" of an objective.

abilities.name: Blades of Eternal Rust

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly Nighthaunt units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ethereal
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly Nighthaunt units, excluding Nagash.

abilities.name: Ethereal Translocation
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Nighthaunt unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mounting Dread
abilities.effect: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly Nighthaunt units.

abilities.name: Sepulchral Apparitions
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: If there is a friendly Nexus of Grief on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional Nexuses of Grief on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly Nexuses of Grief. Designer's Note: *The original* Nexus of Grief *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Infantry or Cavalry Hero that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a Sentenced unit. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Staring Death in the Face
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the target is a Hero, subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Spectral Alchemy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects or roll two dice and apply both corresponding effects in an order of your choosing, including duplicate effects: **1 *Phantasmal Solvent:* If the target has a Move characteristic of '-', inflict 6 mortal damage on the target. 2 *Acidic Fug:* Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. 3 *Fling Concoctions:* Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Hurled Vial this phase but all attacks made by this unit this phase must target that enemy unit. 4 *Choking Vapours:* If the target is a Wizard, subtract 1 from its power level until the start of your next turn. 5 *Fear-laced Hallucinogen:* If the target is a Priest, remove D3 ritual points from it. 6 *Unholy Prescription:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

units.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero non-Unique Death unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly Death unit, pick 1 of the following effects: • Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3. • If the target was not set up this turn and is not in combat, it can move up to 3". It cannot move into combat.

abilities.name: Corpse Candles
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick either this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If you picked this unit, allocate 1 damage point to this unit and add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). If you picked an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit and for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. • Add 1 to this unit's power level.

abilities.name: Grim Justice
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made with this unit's Fellreaper if the target is a Priest or a Wizard.

abilities.name: Wraithstorm
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain as a result of this ability, inflict a further D3 mortal damage on the target

abilities.name: Sentenced to Eternal Torment
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and the target has the Sentenced keyword until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Judge, Jury and Executioner
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Nighthaunt Infantry unit uses a Fight ability, if all of its attacks target the same Sentenced enemy unit, that friendly unit's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for that Fight ability.

abilities.name: Captured Soul Energy
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Cacophony of Sorrow
abilities.effect: While there are any friendly Myrmourn Banshees units wholly within 12" of this unit, ignore positive modifiers to the control scores of enemy units within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Ghostly Howl
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle(Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Runaway Coach
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Nimbus of Power
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Evocation of Death
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly non-Unique Nighthaunt Hero that has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit. The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Spectral Attendants
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn: Noble Blade: This unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (Mortal) instead of Crit (Auto-wound). Unholy Grail: Each time a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points. Tome of Undead Lore: This unit has Wizard (1).

abilities.name: One Stop, No Return
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, attacks made by those units cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Spectral Carriage
abilities.timing: Your Charge Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, they cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (hit rolls that would be critical hits score hits instead).

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn: *Noble Blade:* This unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (Mortal) instead of Crit (Auto-wound). *Unholy Grail:* Pick a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit. Each time that unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points. *Tome of Undead Lore:* This unit has Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Thrashing Desperation
abilities.effect: While this unit contests an objective you control, enemy units cannot finish a charge move within 1/2" of a model in this unit unless the unmodified charge roll was 7 or more.

abilities.name: Another Link in the Chain
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly Spirit Torments. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Nighthaunt units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Chilling Horde
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Chainrasp units to be the targets,
abilities.effect: Each target can move 6" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Black-hearted Lackeys
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 3 to the control scores of friendly Nighthaunt units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Discorporation
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harrowing Shrieks
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Unerring Hunters
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time this unit makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

abilities.name: Reaped Like Corn
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the combat ranges of 5 or more models in this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the target unit has 20 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Spell-eaters
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability
abilities.effect: If a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1). Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability. If the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster

abilities.name: Light a Pyre
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Add a number equal to the roll to this unit's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Drawn to War
abilities.effect: Friendly Nighthaunt Infantry Heroes have Ward (4+) while they are wholly within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Terrifying Spectres
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly Nighthaunt Hero in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.
abilities.effect: You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do: • Apply the effect below. • If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. For the rest of the turn: • Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the enemy target that do not target this unit. • Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls for the enemy target's attacks. • If you picked a friendly target, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy target.

abilities.name: Furious Indictment
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is condemned until the start of your next turn. While a unit is condemned: • Halve that unit's Move characteristic. • That unit cannot use Retreat abilities. • Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for that unit, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Piercing Scream to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: The Briar Queen
abilities.effect: While this unit's Briar Queen is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).
